entities.name: PMID:10738217
observations: Compared 21 typical and 10 atypical bronchopulmonary carcinoids using TUNEL apoptosis assessment and Ki-67 immunohistochemistry.

Mean apoptotic index was low (0.18%); index >0.5% occurred significantly more often in atypical tumors (P<0.008). Ki-67 was low overall but highest in atypical tumors; apoptosis and Ki-67 indices correlated (P<0.01).

entities.name: PMID:9762544
observations: Small cohort of 16 typical and 4 atypical pulmonary carcinoids; atypical tumors showed higher proliferative capacity, but apoptosis incidence was significantly enhanced in typical carcinoids.

entities.name: Atypical carcinoid activity trend
observations: In a 31-tumor comparative study, atypical bronchopulmonary carcinoids more often showed elevated apoptotic index and had the highest Ki-67 proliferation rates, although absolute values were low.

entities.name: Apoptosis result varies
observations: A separate small pulmonary carcinoid cohort found more apoptosis in typical tumors, despite higher proliferative capacity in atypical tumors.
